label: Cogito thinking-root and same-witness essence nodes against actual root existence
summary: Curation pass 2 of #2103 (lane E). The Cogito route's necessary thinking root b401eca0 (producer 60df7e87, consuming the thinker-local premises db72222b and debcd4e1 with producers 601022e8 and 9e38fb0b) had no consumer reaching the root. Result b8b4e9f5 (actualRootOfThinkingRoot, specs/cogito-actual-root.toml) keeps its rootness clause and gives the root-path input dc397705 (ActualRootExistsAt) at the same profile and world. It is a projection: thinking, ancestry and de re necessity are dropped. It opens a support option for dc397705 whose warrant runs through an occurring thought and thinker-local premises instead of a global population, roster or well-foundedness premise. Rejected in the same pass: the analogous projection from the same-witness essence node 63bd518f. That statement links two senses each of NECESSARY (the frame NECESSARY_11 and NECESSARY_2), CAUSE_OF_ESSE_VERSUS_SUFFICIENT_REASON, WORLD_RELATIVE_EXISTENCE_METAPHYSICAL_ESSE_NECESSITY and WELL_FOUNDEDNESS_AND_ANTI_BRUTE_ROOT, so the projection would need four premise-carried sense bridges, one of them registering a frame parameter as a sense passage; that would be a contrived edge for clauses the proof discards.
blocker: 63bd518f and its producers 9d77f415 and 2302a4ef stay unplaced. A consumer would need a root-path statement that uses its essence-esse identity on the same witness (for example the no-limiting-principle root 6c37be2d, which also needs noncomposition and firstness), or a per-sense split of 63bd518f.
